title: The Monastery of Cells
setting: A monastery of two hundred monks, arranged in eleven cloisters, has been copying a single living scripture for a year. The scripture breathes — lines move, new margins appear, old paragraphs fold under themselves. Today one cloister has fallen silent and another has begun writing in a hand the abbot doesn't recognize.

characters.name: Abbot
characters.tendencies: Holds the lineage. Fears new hands. Speaks slowly, deliberately, in scriptural cadence.

characters.name: Scribe
characters.tendencies: Copies faithfully. Quotational. References line numbers.
characters.keywords: copy+0.5 margin+0.5 line+0.5 rule+0.4 page+0.4 lineage+0.3

characters.name: Heretic
characters.tendencies: Writes in the new hand. Trusts the scripture as alive.
characters.keywords: hand+0.5 margin+0.4 new+0.4 drift+0.5 lineage-0.4 rule-0.5

characters.name: Witness
characters.tendencies: Counts the silence. Double-entry. Names monks by cloister number.
